text.observations: All twelve supplied entries read once; serif prose uses five soft meaning-preserving lines. Middle dots are centered, colons have two dots, date/time ranges read as medium-length dashes. Raster shape reading does not certify Unicode encoding.

style.checked_requirement: Substantial interlocking planted silhouettes; dominant mature serif Korean Title, five-line serif body and compatible sans subtitle/practical copy in one connected central reading passage.

observations.location: left crop, right edge and middle-right beside prose
observations.observation: Broad split leaves and attached stems rise from the left coral pot, narrow striped blades rise from the right coral pot, and a medium leafy coral pot occupies the ragged prose-side opening. Plants are substantial page masses with connected growth and visible soil/rims.

observations.location: central opening from top title to last URL
observations.observation: Large leaf shapes and the smaller middle plant determine an uneven opening around different text widths; there is no bounded rectangular information panel or detached tiny image.
Three varying growth silhouettes and coral pots remain major parts of the composition. The Korean serif Title remains the clear primary typographic anchor within their opening.
Different leaf silhouettes, growth scales, attached stems, terracotta pots and visible soil connect the long explanation about choosing small pots through established trees to the home-plant subject.
Serif glyphs have stable syllable bodies, open inner spaces and consistent baseline; Title has much greater scale and thicker strokes than prose. No garbled Hangul observed.
Meaningful word boundaries and paragraph starts remain visible. The finer serif body contrasts with the heavier practical sans.

Market eyebrow identifies the large Korean Title. English companion and promise subtitle are adjacent below. The five prose lines continue down to date/hours; venue/access on the next baseline; then care, invitation and URL, without searching another region.

information_relationship.function_contact: Printed visit details and URL are intact and visually adjacent; no browsing or live URL operation requested.

observations.location: leaf contours, pot rims and overlapping stems
observations.observation: Cut edges are crisp; paper mottling stays in broad botanical surfaces and pottery. Leaves attach to stems and stems meet the visible soil/rims; no detached glyph-like plant tags or erroneous caption marks observed.

decision.reason: No observed copy alteration, missing entry, clipping, ambiguous Hangul or broken reading route warrants a repair. The substantive plants define the central passage and the required Title hierarchy is clear. Keep the inspected first result; the rounding is permitted.
